candidates.title: Engineer / Technical Officer - Road Design (East)
candidates.content_text: Requisition 12067, ongoing full time. Supports design, documentation and delivery of road and traffic engineering projects under supervision: road layouts, intersections, drainage, safety barriers, signage, line marking, 3D modelling in MicroStation and OpenRoads. Selection criteria: collaborative, delivers work effectively, sound judgement, applies foundational engineering knowledge, adaptable and open to developing skills in MicroStation and OpenRoads. Qualifications: Victorian driver's licence, White Card, ability to travel within the state. Applicants must be an Australian Citizen, Permanent Resident or hold a valid work permit or visa. Contact Vincent Nguyen, Senior Manager Road Design, vincent.nguyen@transport.vic.gov.au.
candidates.apply_instructions: Online via the Victorian Government careers portal (careers.vic.gov.au, requisition 12067); VPS roles accept portal applications only.
